methods.primary_tau_estimator: DerSimonian-Laird method of moments, frozen before outcomes; no estimator selected for best agreement. Q=sum(w*(g-mu)^2); C=sumw-sumw_squared/sumw; tau2=max(0,(Q-(k-1))/C); fixedw=1/v; randomw=1/(v+tau2).
methods.input_point: g=printedg; v=printedSE^2 clamped to the intersection of printedSE and variance rounding intervals. This deterministic rule uses sourceprecision alone, never pooled targets.
methods.intervals: Normal95%confidence interval mu +/-1.959963984540054*sqrt(1/sumw). Z=mu/SE, two-sided normalp. Qchi-squaretail dfk-1; I2=100max(0,(Q-df)/Q). Original59effect-independence/normalCI assumption retained; this does not endorse it.
methods.rounding_boxes: glo/gHi=printedg +/-0.0005; vlo/vhi=intersection[(printedSE-.0005)^2,(printedSE+.0005)^2] with[printedvariance-.0005,printedvariance+.0005], lower clippedpositive. Any empty intersection is an input-source inconsistency and stops the central comparison; no source value is adjusted using output targets.
methods.rounding_propagation: For fixed weightedmean lower/upper, solve the extreme residual sumw(g-mu)=0 by bisection, choosing endpointweights for signed residuals with endpointg. SEbounds from inverse totalweightbounds. For Q use weighted-norm triangle inequality at all-low/all-high weights around printedg, with errornorm .0005sqrt(sumw). C is monotone in eachpositiveweight, so endpointC bounds; DLtau2 bounds follow (Q-df)/C. Randomweight bounds follow vlo/vhi and tau2lo/hi; propagate weightedmean/SE/CI/Z/p as above. Expand computed endpoints by1e-9 for arithmetic guard, independently verify all bound arithmetic with80-digit implementation. Rounding envelopes are separate from sampling95%CIs.
